scope: Identifies the calibration source used by the prior IQ2_XS experiment, adds an opt-in exact-token llama.cpp iMatrix path for the RESMP-DEV standard Qwen3.8 view, and completes a real Qwen3.8-Flash-Next importance matrix. No setup default or quantized model release changed.

findings: llama.cpp natively accepts raw calibration text with -f, fixes a chunk size, and can merge/resume iMatrix GGUF checkpoints.
K-Transformers' GPTQ path names a dataset/split, applies the model chat template, tokenizes and truncates to 2048, shuffles with seed 42, and limits calibration to 512 samples.
Strata follows explicit sample identity rather than silently treating a different raw-text split as the standard view.
